points: 84% fear wrong decisions from false or invented information
78% each see risks from new interface gaps, data leaks and unwanted actions; 74% from unclear liability

take: New agent-specific results from the BSI/TÜV survey: firms fear wrong decisions, data leaks and unwanted actions. TÜV calls for independent pre-market testing of frontier models.
title: TÜV-Verband: most German firms see high risks in AI agents
